name: 通过 SAP Fieldglass 的外部劳动力采购 (22K)
name_en: External Workforce Procurement via SAP Fieldglass (22K)
description_en_html:
Overview

Activate the integration of SAP Fieldglass with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to support, automate, and extend SAP S/4HANA external worker and statement of work hiring and management processes.

You benefit with this integration when you digitize the processing of job postings and statements of work. After hiring an external resource, a work order is created in SAP Fieldglass. Purchase requisition and order creation is triggered in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition automatically. When the project manager approves the external worker's submitted time, a service entry sheet is created in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition through this integration. Finally, a supplier invoice is generated in SAP Fieldglass based on the purchase order and the service entry sheet. Once the supplier accepts this invoice, it is posted to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for the accounts payable accountant to process.

Key Process Flow

  • Create purchase requisition in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition for each job posting (after creation of work order) and statement of work
  • Approve purchase requisition inside SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition (optional)
  • Create purchase order for each work order in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Approve purchase order inside SAP S/4HANA (optional)
  • Submit time in SAP Fieldglass for manager approval
  • Create service entry sheet in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
  • Propose invoice to supplier based on submitted time in SAP Fieldglass
  • Post invoice in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition after supplier approves invoice proposal

Business Benefits

  • Enable timely and automated payment while reducing the cost and risk of outstanding payments
  • Support accurate, consistent, and compliant booking of time and expenses for external workforce
  • Increase productivity with integrated creation of purchase requisition, purchase order, service entry sheet, and supplier invoice
  • Increase data consistency throughout the systems by replicating master data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to SAP Fieldglass
description_zh_html:
概览

激活 SAP Fieldglass 与 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 的集成，以支持、自动化和扩展 SAP S/4HANA 外部员工和工作声明雇用和管理流程。

在数字化职位发布和工作声明的处理时，您可以通过此集成受益。雇用外部资源后，将在 SAP Fieldglass 中创建工作订单。在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中自动触发采购申请和订单创建。项目经理批准外部员工的提交时间后，会通过此集成在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中创建服务条目表。最后，根据采购订单和服务条目表在 SAP Fieldglass 中生成供应商发票。供应商接受此发票后，会将其过账到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 以供应付账款会计处理。

关键流程流

  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中为每个职位发布（创建工单后）和工作声明创建采购申请
  • 批准 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中的采购申请（可选）
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中为每个工单创建采购订单
  • 审批 SAP S/4HANA 内的采购订单（可选）
  • 在 SAP Fieldglass 中提交时间以供经理审批
  • 在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中创建服务条目表
  • 根据 SAP Fieldglass 中的提交时间向供应商建议发票
  • 供应商批准发票建议后，在 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中过账发票

业务优势

  • 支持及时自动付款，同时降低未清付款的成本和风险
  • 确保外部员工时间和费用的准确、一致和合规登记
  • 通过集成创建采购申请、采购订单、服务条目表和供应商发票来提高生产力
  • 通过将主数据从 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 复制到 SAP Fieldglass，提高整个系统的数据一致性
